summary_zh: 共形反事实推断技术可让网络运营商利用已记录的遥测数据可靠回答网络运行相关的“假设分析”类问题，这类回答通常以预测集的形式呈现：预测集可按照用户自定义的概率，包含在替代控制操作下本应观测到的关键绩效指标（KPI）。该领域的核心挑战在于，已记录的遥测数据可能遗漏控制器使用的部分变量，进而产生隐藏混淆，破坏反事实分析的统计保证。理论上该问题可通过随机遥测技术解决：即通过独立于网络状态分配控制操作的方式采集数据。但这类随机操作可能干扰网络正常运行，因此随机遥测数据通常十分稀缺，仅基于这类数据的反事实分析会生成不具备参考价值的预测集。为解决上述挑战，本文提出Confounding-Valid Counterfactual Conformal Inference (CV-CCI，混淆有效反事实共形推断)，该方法基于General Synthetic-Powered Inference (GESPI，通用合成驱动推断) 原理，将大量可能存在混淆的观测遥测数据与少量随机数据相结合。CV-CCI利用观测数据提升推断效率，同时借助随机数据保证在任意隐藏混淆场景下的有限样本覆盖保证。在两类代表性无线接入网（RAN）控制任务上的实验表明，CV-CCI在隐藏混淆场景下仍可保持有效性，且生成的预测集比现有最先进的混淆有效基线方法效率更高。

title: Impact of Data Loss in Postprocessing on Training and Inference of Quantum Neural Networks
title_zh: 后处理阶段数据丢失对量子神经网络训练与推理的影响
authors: Soraya V. Panambalom, Edoardo Altamura, Nick Chancellor, Jonte R. Hance
abstract: As quantum hardware scales to larger devices, the classical software layers that interface with it must evolve in step. Postprocessing routines developed and tested primarily in simulator settings can encode assumptions that no longer hold on utility-scale devices, leading to data loss that can be difficult to detect from high-level model outputs alone. We present a case study of \texttt{SamplerQNN}, the sampling-based quantum neural network class in the Qiskit Machine Learning library. Here, the postprocessing method applies a filter that assumes measurement bit-strings are in virtual qubit space. On our quantum hardware runs, where bit-strings span over 100 physical qubits, this filter led to the loss of 85 to 99.6\% of valid measurement shots, depending on the transpiler's qubit placement. The resulting probability vector is unnormalised, allowing distorted prediction and loss values to propagate through the model without an API-level warning. We demonstrate the impact across five experiments on two IBM backends: for inference, accuracy drops from 0.94 to 0.39 on the same raw measurements; for training, the loss signal is compressed by 22 to 27$\times$, substantially reducing the sensitivity of the optimiser to the objective landscape. The behaviour arises in all released versions of the library (0.8.4 to 0.9.0). We implemented a layout-based marginalisation fix, merged into the GitHub codebase as Pull Request \#1041, that makes \texttt{SamplerQNN} postprocessing forward-compatible with current and upcoming hardware.
summary_zh: 随着量子硬件规模不断扩大，与之对接的经典软件层也需要同步迭代。主要在模拟器环境下开发测试的后处理例程可能引入在实用级量子设备上不再成立的假设，进而引发仅从高层模型输出难以检测的数据丢失问题。本文针对Qiskit机器学习库中基于采样的量子神经网络类	exttt{SamplerQNN}开展案例研究：该类的后处理方法采用了一个假设测量比特串位于虚拟量子比特空间的过滤器。在我们的量子硬件运行实验中，比特串覆盖超过100个物理量子比特，该过滤器导致85%至99.6%的有效测量采样丢失，具体丢失比例取决于转译器的量子比特布局策略。最终得到的概率向量未归一化，导致失真的预测值与损失值可在无API级别警告的前提下在模型中传播。我们在两台IBM后端设备上开展5组实验验证该影响：推理场景下，相同原始测量数据的准确率从0.94降至0.39；训练场景下，损失信号被压缩22至27倍，大幅降低了优化器对目标景观的敏感度。该问题存在于该库所有已发布版本（0.8.4至0.9.0）中。我们实现了一种基于布局的边缘化修复方案，已作为Pull Request #1041合并至GitHub代码库，使	exttt{SamplerQNN}的后处理可向前兼容当前与未来的量子硬件。

title: An Analysis of Self-supervised Pre-training with Dependent Samples
title_zh: 基于依赖样本的自监督预训练分析
authors: Maximilian Fleissner, Debarghya Ghoshdastidar, Samory Kpotufe
abstract: Self-supervised learning relies on so-called data augmentations $\phi(x)$ of unlabeled datapoints $x$ --- for example, masking random pixels in an image $x$ --- that should leave the label of $x$ invariant and are often used to learn a lower-complexity invariant subspace $\cal V$ for downstream tasks. In practice, such augmentations $\{ \phi_l(x_i) \}$ are pooled together to learn $\cal V$, despite obvious inter-dependencies between different augmentations $\phi_l(x), \phi_k(x)$ of the same datapoint $x$. However, theoretical works on the subject typically consider procedures that avoid such dependencies, and are therefore limited to operate on smaller subsets of independent data.We show in this work that pooling augmentations together, despite inter-dependencies, is a better alternative than the baseline of partitioning the data into subsets of independent data. More precisely, in the context of estimating $\cal V$, the statistical estimation error bounds for pooling are never worse than the partitioning baseline, and in some cases --- such as masking or noise injection-based augmentations over a shallow neural network --- naive pooling leads to faster rates in terms of the number of augmentations. The benefits of pooling are particularly prominent when the correlations between different augmentations $\phi_l(x), \phi_k(x)$ have mild effects on estimation or help decrease the estimation variance. The analysis, therefore, yields new insights into the success of pooling augmented samples in self-supervised pre-training, and provides an intuition behind the practical preference towards using many augmentations.
summary_zh: 自监督学习依赖于无标签数据点$x$的数据增强操作$\phi(x)$（例如对图像$x$的随机像素进行掩码），这类操作应保持$x$的标签不变，通常用于为下游任务学习复杂度更低的不变子空间$\cal V$。实践中，尽管同一数据点$x$的不同增强结果$\phi_l(x), \phi_k(x)$之间存在明显的相互依赖关系，研究者仍会将所有增强结果$\{ \phi_l(x_i) \}$集中在一起来学习$\cal V$。但该领域的理论研究通常会刻意规避这类依赖，因此仅能在规模更小的独立数据子集上开展分析。本文研究表明，尽管存在相互依赖，将增强结果集中使用的效果仍优于将数据划分为独立子集的基线方案。更准确地说，在估计不变子空间$\cal V$的场景下，集中策略的统计估计误差上界绝不会差于划分基线方案；在部分场景下（例如浅层神经网络上基于掩码或噪声注入的增强操作），简单的集中策略可在增强样本数量维度实现更快的误差下降速率。当不同增强结果$\phi_l(x), \phi_k(x)$之间的相关性对估计的影响较轻微，或有助于降低估计方差时，集中策略的优势尤为突出。该分析为自监督预训练中集中使用增强样本的优异表现提供了全新洞见，也解释了实践中研究者倾向于使用大量增强样本的底层逻辑。

title: Solution-space heterogeneity shapes federated learning dynamics across partial differential equations
title_zh: 解空间异质性塑造跨偏微分方程的联邦学习动态特性
authors: Ping Luo, Jiahuan Wang, Ziqing Wen, Tao Sun, Dongsheng Li
abstract: Federated scientific machine learning enables institutions to train neural surrogates without centralizing local physical data, yet studies of partial differential equations (PDEs) lack a transferable definition of non-independent and identically distributed data. Existing protocols partition coordinates, coefficients, boundary conditions, or geometries according to equation-specific rules. Here, we introduce solution-space PDE-Dirichlet, a protocol that converts continuous supervised responses into reusable solution bins and quantifies the realized separation between clients through optimal transport over the geometry of these bins. We derive an exact inverse relation between population allocation heterogeneity and the Dirichlet concentration, and we establish conditions under which response heterogeneity induces gradient disagreement, local-update dispersion, and parameter divergence. Across seven controlled and public PDE tasks, three neural-operator families, and five random seeds, a lower concentration consistently increases the realized solution distance and optimization heterogeneity. The degradation in final error is task dependent: the largest effect occurs for low-viscosity Burgers, reaching 4.157 percentage points under the most heterogeneous setting, whereas additional communication or smoother dynamics can reduce the final gap despite persistent parameter separation. These results distinguish a reproducible geometric mechanism from task-dependent generalization outcomes and provide a common basis for evaluating non-IID federated PDE learning.
summary_zh: 联邦科学机器学习可让多个机构在不集中本地物理数据的前提下训练神经代理模型，但当前针对偏微分方程（PDE）的相关研究缺乏可迁移的非独立同分布数据定义，现有协议均根据特定方程的规则对坐标、系数、边界条件或几何结构进行划分。本文提出解空间PDE-Dirichlet协议，该协议可将连续监督响应转换为可复用的解区间，并通过解区间几何结构上的最优传输量化不同客户端之间的实际分离程度。我们推导得出总体分配异质性与Dirichlet浓度之间的精确逆相关关系，明确了响应异质性引发梯度不一致、本地更新离散与参数发散的条件。在7组受控公开PDE任务、3类神经算子族、5组随机种子的实验设置下，更低的浓度值会持续提升实际解空间距离与优化异质性。最终误差的劣化程度与任务相关：低粘度Burgers方程受影响最大，在异质性最高的场景下误差上升4.157个百分点，而额外的通信轮次或更平滑的动态特性可在参数持续分离的前提下缩小最终误差差距。上述结果将可复现的几何机制与任务相关的泛化结果区分开，为评估非独立同分布场景下的联邦PDE学习提供了通用基准。

title: Beyond Homoscedasticity: Decoupled Uncertainty Optimization for Deep Imbalanced Regression
title_zh: 超越同方差：面向深度不平衡回归的解耦不确定性优化
authors: Juncheng Zhou, Jiaxi Lu, Weijing Zeng, Zhong Li, Hao Qi 等 (6 人)
abstract: Deep Imbalanced Regression (DIR) is pervasive in continuous prediction tasks across diverse modalities, such as age estimation, depth prediction, and protein mutation activity prediction, where label-scarce tail samples often carry higher practical value. However, most existing methods still learn deterministic point mappings under mean squared error or its simple variants, implicitly assuming a uniform uncertainty level across all samples and thereby overlooking the instance-wise heteroscedasticity that is widespread in long-tailed data. We further point out that even heteroscedastic negative log-likelihood suffers from a gradient coupling issue, which, under DIR scenarios, weakens the learning signal of hard tail samples and leads to optimization inertia as well as tail underfitting. To address this, we propose DUO, an uncertainty-aware long-tailed regression framework. Specifically, the proposed method models the regression target as a conditional Gaussian distribution to explicitly characterize instance-level predictive uncertainty, and transforms uncertainty into a dynamic enhancement signal for tail samples through decoupled mean-variance optimization. Furthermore, we design a distribution-guided contrastive learning mechanism that adaptively constructs positive and negative pairs based on the overlap between sample distributions, thereby alleviating feature looseness and cross-label semantic entanglement. Across visual and biological DIR benchmarks, DUO achieves the best few-shot bMAE and GM on IMDB-WIKI-DIR, AgeDB-DIR, and AAV2-DIR while remaining competitive on few-shot MAE.
summary_zh: 深度不平衡回归（DIR）广泛存在于多模态连续预测任务中，例如年龄估计、深度预测、蛋白质突变活性预测等场景，标签稀缺的尾部样本通常具备更高的实用价值。但现有大多数方法仍在均方误差或其简单变体下学习确定性点映射，隐式假设所有样本的不确定性水平一致，忽略了长尾数据中普遍存在的实例级异方差特性。本文进一步指出，即使是异方差负对数似然方法也存在梯度耦合问题，在DIR场景下会弱化难分尾部样本的学习信号，引发优化惰性与尾部欠拟合问题。为解决该问题，本文提出DUO，一种面向长尾回归的不确定性感知框架。该方法将回归目标建模为条件高斯分布，显式刻画实例级预测不确定性，并通过解耦均值-方差优化将不确定性转换为针对尾部样本的动态增强信号。此外本文设计了分布引导的对比学习机制，可基于样本分布之间的重叠度自适应构造正负样本对，缓解特征松散与跨标签语义纠缠问题。在视觉与生物领域的DIR基准数据集上，DUO在IMDB-WIKI-DIR、AgeDB-DIR与AAV2-DIR数据集上取得了最优的小样本平衡平均绝对误差（bMAE）与几何均值（GM），同时小样本平均绝对误差（MAE）也保持了极具竞争力的表现。

title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
title_zh: BeaconKV：基于信标查询引导的键值缓存压缩实现高效大推理模型推理
authors: Janghyeon Kim, Minsoo Kim, Kyuhong Shim, Jungwook Choi
abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve superior problem-solving through extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation, but the resulting key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and creates severe memory bottlenecks, often exceeding GPU capacity for long reasoning traces. Existing KV cache compression methods rely on recent queries to estimate future token importance, implicitly assuming these serve as reliable proxies for future attention patterns. We demonstrate that this assumption fails in long-horizon reasoning: certain decoding steps generate Thought Revisiting Tokens (TRT) that re-attend to distant previous context, such as task-solving plans formulated early in the trace. Through systematic analysis, we discover that queries corresponding to the TRT cluster into a small number of similarity groups in the embedding space. Based on this insight, we propose BeaconKV, a training-free KV cache compression method that maintains beacon queries, compact representatives for each global query cluster, to anticipate which KV pairs will be revisited without storing the entire query history. Across four open-source LRMs and diverse reasoning benchmarks, BeaconKV generally outperforms existing compression methods, achieving up to $5.8\times$ memory reduction while nearly preserving full cache accuracy and improving throughput by over $4.3\times$.
summary_zh: 大推理模型（LRM）通过生成长思维链（CoT）实现了优异的问题求解能力，但由此产生的键值（KV）缓存会随序列长度线性增长，引发严重的内存瓶颈，长推理轨迹场景下往往超出GPU的容量上限。现有KV缓存压缩方法依赖近期查询估计未来token的重要性，隐式假设近期查询可作为未来注意力模式的可靠代理。本文通过实验证明该假设在长程推理场景下并不成立：部分解码步骤会生成思维重访token（TRT），这类token会重新关注距离当前位置很远的前文上下文，例如推理轨迹早期生成的任务求解方案。通过系统性分析，我们发现TRT对应的查询在嵌入空间中会聚类为少量相似组。基于该发现，本文提出BeaconKV，一种无需额外训练的KV缓存压缩方法，该方法维护信标查询（即每个全局查询簇的紧凑代表），无需存储全部查询历史即可预判哪些KV对会被后续操作重访。在4个开源LRM与多类推理基准上的实验表明，BeaconKV整体表现优于现有压缩方法，最高可实现5.8倍的内存缩减，同时几乎保留全缓存的精度，将吞吐量提升4.3倍以上。

title: Fractal basins trap latent reasoning
title_zh: 分形盆捕获潜在推理过程
authors: Jeffrey Lai, Anthony Bao, John Quinn, William Gilpin
abstract: Reasoning allows artificial intelligence models to revisit and correct their mistakes, enabling recent frontier advances in mathematical theorem solving, software engineering, and autonomous task planning. Reasoning models are widely observed to reason for longer on harder tasks, but the general mechanism responsible for these slowdowns is unknown. Here, we show that reasoning models exhibit transient chaos, a physical consequence of the computational complexity of difficult tasks. As a consequence, we show that diverse leading reasoning models are dynamical systems with fractal basins, with fractality increasing with task difficulty across diverse tasks like Sudoku and maze solving, visual puzzles, and mathematical logic. We show that transient chaos emerges due to reasoning becoming trapped for extended durations near saddle points, which we show correspond to nearly-correct attempted solutions of the underlying problem. Our results show that reasoning slowdowns are an inevitable consequence of problem hardness in modern artificial intelligence models, and establish reasoning traces as a rich new class of dynamical system.
summary_zh: 推理能力让人工智能模型可以重审并修正自身错误，推动了近期数学定理求解、软件工程、自主任务规划领域的前沿进展。现有研究普遍观测到推理模型在难度更高的任务上推理耗时更长，但引发这类减速现象的通用机制仍不明确。本文研究表明，推理模型会表现出瞬态混沌特性，这是高难度任务计算复杂度带来的物理结果。据此我们证明，多种主流推理模型均属于具备分形盆的动力系统，在数独求解、迷宫求解、视觉谜题、数理逻辑等不同任务上，分形程度均随任务难度提升而升高。瞬态混沌的产生原因是推理过程会在鞍点附近长时间停滞，这类鞍点对应底层问题接近正确的尝试解。研究结果表明，推理减速是现代人工智能模型在高难度问题上的必然结果，同时也证明推理轨迹是一类全新的、内涵丰富的动力系统。

title: Physics-Aware Random Walk Fingerprints for Scalable Power Grid Graph Classification
title_zh: 面向可扩展电网图分类的物理感知随机游走指纹
authors: Adnan Anwar
abstract: Recent benchmarks such as PowerGraph provide large collections of power-grid graphs for cascading-failure classification. Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong predictive performance on this task, but typically require end-to-end training and model-specific tuning, while their latent representations can be difficult to relate to physically meaningful propagation patterns. Random Walk Fingerprints (RWF) offer a scalable and interpretable alternative, but existing variants primarily emphasise topology and node-level information, leaving grid-relevant operational edge states in the walk dynamics. We propose Multi-Channel Physics-Aware Random Walk Fingerprints (MC-PA-RWF) for power systems, a lightweight graph-level representation framework that introduces physical edge states into random-walk propagation. The method constructs multiple edge-weighted channels from domain-relevant attributes, extracts a channel-specific fingerprint from each weighted graph, and concatenates the resulting vectors into a compact representation. Experiments on three \textit{PowerGraph} benchmark systems show substantial improvements over topology-only RWF and competitive balanced accuracy against strong GNN baselines, including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN), Graph Attention Networks (GAT), Graph Isomorphism Networks with edge features (GINE), and Transformer-based Graph Convolutional Networks (TransformerConv). At the largest evaluated settings, the node-edge extension MC-PA-RWF+ achieves around 98.04% - 99.32% balanced accuracy and improves failure-class F1 over the strongest GNN baseline by 1.60 -- 5.84 percentage points, with statistically significant gains across all three systems.
summary_zh: PowerGraph等近期基准数据集提供了大量用于级联故障分类的电网图样本。图神经网络（GNN）在该任务上取得了优异的预测性能，但通常需要端到端训练与模型专属调优，且其学习到的隐表示很难与物理层面有意义的传播模式建立关联。随机游走指纹（RWF）是一种具备可扩展性与可解释性的替代方案，但现有变体主要关注拓扑结构与节点级信息，未将电网相关的运行边状态纳入游走动态过程。本文提出面向电力系统的多通道物理感知随机游走指纹（MC-PA-RWF），这是一种轻量级的图级表示框架，可将物理边状态引入随机游走传播过程。该方法基于领域相关属性构造多个边加权通道，从每个加权图中提取通道专属指纹，最终将所有得到的向量拼接为紧凑表示。在3个PowerGraph基准系统上的实验表明，该方法的性能相比仅使用拓扑信息的RWF有大幅提升，平衡精度可与图卷积网络（GCN）、图注意力网络（GAT）、带边特征的图同构网络（GINE）、基于Transformer的图卷积网络（TransformerConv）等强GNN基线相竞争。在最大评估设置下，节点边扩展版本MC-PA-RWF+可实现98.04%~99.32%的平衡精度，故障分类F1值相比最优GNN基线提升1.60~5.84个百分点，在全部3个系统上的提升均具备统计显著性。

title: Fast Gauss Sums via Flash Attention
title_zh: 基于Flash Attention（快速注意力）的快速高斯求和
authors: Nicolaj Rux, Sebastian Neumayer
abstract: Gaussian kernel sums are the computational core of maximum mean discrepancies (MMDs), kernel gradient flows, Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD), and many other kernel methods. At the same time, softmax attention has received an extraordinary amount of hardware-aware code engineering, culminating in flash attention. We show that Gauss kernel sums with arbitrary, signed weights can be evaluated via flash attention: two small input augmentations turn the normalized softmax reduction into the unnormalized Gauss sum, without writing a single line of custom GPU code. For feature dimension D>8 in fp16, this approach beats compiled PyTorch code as well as PyKeOps kernels (often significantly) in speed, memory-overhead and accuracy. Indeed, its memory scaling remains linear.
summary_zh: 高斯核求和是最大均值差异（MMD）、核梯度流、斯坦变分梯度下降（SVGD）以及诸多其他核方法的计算核心。与此同时，软注意力机制已经得到了大量面向硬件优化的代码工程支持，最终催生了Flash Attention技术。本文证明，任意带符号权重的高斯核求和都可以通过Flash Attention实现：仅需两次小规模的输入增强操作，即可将归一化的softmax约简转换为未归一化的高斯求和，无需编写任何自定义GPU代码。在精度为fp16、特征维度D>8的场景下，该方法在速度、内存开销和精度三个维度上的表现均优于编译后的PyTorch代码以及PyKeOps核函数，且优势通常十分显著，其内存缩放特性始终保持线性。

title: From Deep to Shallow: Unconstrained and Efficient Layer Merging Strategy
title_zh: 从深到浅：无约束高效的层合并策略
authors: Petro Shulzhenko, Gabriele Spadaro, Enzo Tartaglione
abstract: Although Deep Neural Networks have become foundational in many areas of Machine Learning, high computational demands limit their application in resource-constrained environments. To address this issue, depth compression methods have been proposed to identify and linearize redundant activation functions, thereby allowing for the merging of layers without intermediate non-linearities. However, these methods face two key challenges: they cannot be directly applied to convolutions with padding due to the absence of an analytical solution for merging these layers, and they typically increase the kernel size of merged layers, thus limiting speed-up gains. To overcome these limitations, we propose an efficient strategy that enables merging of layers without an existing analytical solution, and also without increasing kernel size. We validate our approach across multiple architectures and datasets, and measure inference speed-up gains on real embedded platforms. We publicly released the code atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络已经成为机器学习诸多领域的基础，但其高计算需求限制了它在资源受限环境下的落地应用。为解决该问题，现有研究提出了深度压缩方法，通过识别冗余激活函数并对其做线性化处理，实现移除中间非线性层的层合并操作。但这类方法存在两个核心缺陷：由于不存在带填充卷积的层合并解析解，这类方法无法直接应用于带填充的卷积操作；同时这类方法通常会增大合并后层的核尺寸，进而限制加速比的提升空间。为克服上述局限，本文提出了一种高效的层合并策略，无需依赖已有的解析解即可完成层合并，且不会增大核尺寸。本文在多种网络架构和数据集上验证了所提方法的有效性，并在真实嵌入式平台上测试了推理加速增益。相关代码已开源。

title: When Genomic Masking Priors Fail to Transfer: Strong Variant Prediction, Weak Functional Generation
title_zh: 基因组掩码先验迁移失效场景：变异预测性能优异，功能生成能力不足
authors: Susu Hu, Preetam Gattogi, Jens Lehmann, Sahar Vahdati, Stefanie Speidel 等 (6 人)
abstract: Bidirectional discrete diffusion model appears naturally suited to genomic modeling because it can reconstruct missing sequence from both flanks. We developed GenDA (Genomic Density-optimized Absorbing Diffusion) under the additional hypothesis that entropy-guided span placement would concentrate reconstruction pressure on compositionally complex regions, improving both downstream variant-effect prediction and functional sequence generation. Our results only partially support this premise. After supervised fine-tuning, the 202M-parameter GenDA model reaches a pooled ClinVar SNV AUROC of 0.774, exceeding a similarly scaled autoregressive model by 0.103. However, a matched random-span variant reaches 0.777, providing no evidence that entropy guidance causes the ClinVar improvement. More unexpectedly, GenDA fails a zero-shot functional inpainting stress test: across promoters, enhancers, exon boundaries, and intron boundaries, it does not consistently outperform a control that shuffles the native gap while exactly preserving 3-mer composition. Failure is already present for 50--500-bp gaps, although enhancer degradation worsens at longer gaps. Diagnostics identify several boundary conditions: entropy measures local sequence complexity rather than functional importance; 1-mer tokenization limits physical context; training spans are capped at 300 bp; and high absolute AlphaGenome fidelity can coexist with negative control-normalized restoration. These results show that strong fine-tuned variant prediction, a plausible corruption prior, and functional generation are distinct claims that require separate validation.
summary_zh: 双向离散扩散模型天然适配基因组建模任务，它可以从序列的两侧侧翼区域重建缺失片段。本文开发了GenDA（基因组密度优化吸收扩散模型），该模型基于额外假设：熵引导的跨度放置策略可以将重建压力集中在组成结构复杂的区域，同时提升下游变异效应预测和功能序列生成的性能。但实验结果仅部分支持该假设：经过监督微调后，参数量为202M的GenDA模型在合并ClinVar单核苷酸变异（SNV）数据集上的AUROC（受试者工作特征曲线下面积）达到0.774，比同规模的自回归模型高出0.103；但与之匹配的随机跨度变体也达到了0.777的AUROC，没有证据表明熵引导机制带来了ClinVar数据集上的性能提升。更出乎意料的是，GenDA在零样本功能补全压力测试中表现失效：在启动子、增强子、外显子边界、内含子边界场景下，其性能没有持续优于打乱原生间隙但严格保留3-mer组成的对照组。该失效现象在50-500bp的间隙长度下就已出现，且间隙长度更长时增强子区域的性能下降会进一步加剧。经诊断，研究人员识别出多个边界条件：熵度量的是局部序列复杂度而非功能重要性，1-mer分词机制限制了物理上下文的覆盖范围，训练跨度的上限为300bp，AlphaGenome的高绝对保真度可以和低于归一化对照组的恢复性能共存。上述结果表明，微调后优异的变异预测性能、合理的损坏先验、功能生成能力是三个相互独立的目标，需要分别做针对性验证。

title: KVMem: Virtualizing Million-Token Agent Workspaces on a Consumer GPU
title_zh: 基于逐层多阈值随机草图的通信高效个性化联邦学习
authors: Di Chai, Leye Wang, Zeshen Su, Zhiguo Xia, Zhihang Yu
abstract: Modern LLM agents operate in persistent workspaces whose accumulated history can exceed both GPU KV capacity and the model's native context window. Existing systems typically compact older context into summaries or retrieve it later as text, either losing fine-grained execution evidence or repeatedly prefilling content that the model has already processed. We present KVMem, a KV-context virtualization system that preserves overflowed workspace history as paged KV state across GPU memory, host memory, and NVMe. KVMem uses lightweight, model-native attention-space indexes to select relevant historical blocks and materializes a query-dependent execution view bounded by the model's native context window. Extensive evaluations on long-context agent benchmarks spanning histories up to one million tokens, including LongMemEval, MemoryAgentBench, and AgentLongBench, show that KVMem generally achieves higher task utility and greater inference efficiency than compaction-based approaches, the de facto standard for handling context overflow. In the DeepSWE long-context test with Qwen3.8-27B, KVMem improves task success from 43.8% with compaction-only context management to 48.4%.In our local-deployment evaluation, KVMem runs Qwen3.6/3.8-27B NVFP4 with MTP on an off-the-shelf laptop equipped with a 24\,GB RTX 5090 Laptop GPU, virtualizing agent workspaces of up to 1M tokens-four times the model's native 256K-token context window. In a single-session setting, KVMem generates $\sim$50 tokens/s, providing interactive responsiveness for local agent execution. More broadly, by decoupling addressable workspace size from the LLM's native context window, KVMem provides a practical path toward long-running agents whose workspaces can grow beyond that window.
summary_zh: 个性化联邦学习（PFL）是面向分布式设备协同学习的极具前景的范式，边缘节点无需共享原始数据即可协同训练个性化模型。尽管个性化联邦学习通过学习客户端专属模型解决了数据异质性问题，但在带宽受限的系统中交换高维参数时，仍会产生极高的上下行通信开销。近期提出的单比特压缩方法实现了极致的压缩率，但这类方法通常依赖于应用在整个模型上的单阈值规则，该设计存在两个缺陷：第一，它忽略了不同层参数分布和量化敏感度的逐层差异；第二，单阈值仅能提供粗糙的二值信息，无法捕捉参数分布的细粒度变化。为解决上述问题，本文提出了一种基于逐层多阈值随机草图的通信高效个性化联邦学习框架。所提方法为每一层分配独立的量化阈值集合，使得压缩后的表示可以适配层专属的统计特性，同时通过多个区间为草图参数提供更精细的低比特描述。该方法支持使用紧凑低比特草图的双向通信，与现有单比特压缩方法相比，实现了通信开销与精度之间更优的权衡。

title: PACE: Propagation-Aware Collaborative Correction for One-Shot Personalized Federated Graph Learning
title_zh: PACE：面向单样本个性化联邦图学习的传播感知协同校正方法
authors: Ruizhe Huang, Chengran Li, Xiaochuan Shi
abstract: Client heterogeneity creates both an opportunity and a risk in personalized federated graph learning. Knowledge held by other subgraphs may complement a receiver's Local model, but an incompatible transfer can override reliable predictions. One-shot communication sharpens this tension because an unsuitable server return cannot be corrected later. We introduce PACE, which treats collaborative knowledge as a compact correction to a complete Local predictor rather than as its replacement. Each client uploads a rank-r update carrier and a diagonal sketch of propagated message moments. The server uses them to construct a propagation-aware, receiver-anchored correction, while the receiver retains its full Local model. Convex negative-log-likelihood calibration (CNLL) then selects one coefficient between Local and External logits using validation nodes; model parameters remain fixed and no feedback is sent. At Rank-6, personalized returns occupy 9.6-17.6% of dense tensor bytes across the six evaluated datasets. The correction receives nonzero weight and improves both Accuracy and weighted-F1 over Local on five datasets; on ogbn-arxiv, CNLL assigns zero predictive weight to the correction and preserves Local predictions exactly. Applying the same CNLL rule to matched baselines on three citation datasets does not account for these gains. The central result is therefore that a small transported correction can augment a complete Local model when receiver evidence supports it while leaving the Local prediction unchanged otherwise.
summary_zh: 客户端异质性在个性化联邦图学习中同时带来了机遇和风险：其他子图持有的知识可以补充接收方的本地模型，但不兼容的知识迁移会覆盖可靠的预测结果。单样本通信场景进一步加剧了这一矛盾，因为不合适的服务器返回结果无法在后续流程中得到校正。本文提出PACE方法，将协同知识视为对完整本地预测器的紧凑校正而非直接替换。每个客户端上传一个秩-r更新载体和传播消息矩的对角草图，服务器利用这些信息构建传播感知、以接收方为锚点的校正项，而接收方保留其完整的本地模型。随后通过凸负对数似然校准（CNLL）使用验证节点选择本地和外部logit之间的系数，整个过程中模型参数保持固定，且无需向客户端发送反馈。在秩为6的设置下，6个评估数据集上个性化返回结果的体积仅占对应密集张量字节的9.6%-17.6%。该校正项获得非零权重，在5个数据集上相比本地模型同时提升了准确率和加权F1值；在ogbn-arxiv数据集上，CNLL给校正项分配零预测权重，完全保留本地预测结果。将相同的CNLL规则应用于三个引文数据集的匹配基线无法复现上述性能增益。因此核心结论是：当接收方的证据支持校正生效时，少量传输的校正项可以增强完整本地模型，否则不会改变本地预测结果。

title: Communication-Efficient Personalized Federated Learning via Layer-Wise Multi-Threshold Random Sketching
authors: Xu Zhang, Xingyu Hou, Jiacheng Cheng, Kaiyuan Feng, Maoguo Gong
abstract: Personalized federated learning (PFL) is a promising paradigm for collaborative learning over distributed devices, where edge nodes collaboratively train personalized models without sharing raw data. Although PFL addresses data heterogeneity by learning client-specific models, it still suffers from substantial uplink and downlink communication costs when exchanging high-dimensional parameters in bandwidth-constrained systems. Recent one-bit methods achieve extreme compression, but they usually rely on a single thresholding rule applied to the whole model. This design has two limitations. First, it overlooks layer-wise differences in parameter distributions and quantization sensitivities. Second, a single threshold provides only coarse binary information and cannot capture fine-grained variations in parameter distributions. To address these issues, we propose a communication-efficient PFL framework via layer-wise multi-threshold random sketching. In the proposed method, each layer is assigned its own set of quantization thresholds, so that the compressed representation can adapt to layer-specific statistics while using multiple intervals to provide a finer low-bit description of sketched parameters. The proposed method supports bidirectional communication using compact low-bit sketches and improves the communication-accuracy tradeoff compared with existing one-bit compression approaches.

title: Minimax Lower Bound for Estimating Diffusion-based Local Intrinsic Dimension
title_zh: 基于扩散的局部本征维度估计的极小极大下界
authors: Jaehee Seo, Wontae Jeong, Jisu Kim
abstract: While diffusion-based methods have recently emerged as effective tools for probing the intrinsic geometry of high-dimensional data, their statistical difficulty remains largely unexplored. We study estimation of the finite-scale population functional underlying FLIPD (Kamkari et al., 2024;arXiv:2406.03537), a diffusion-based local intrinsic dimension (LID) quantity defined through the logarithmic scale derivative of a Gaussian-smoothed density. Intuitively, Gaussian smoothing turns local dimension into a scale law: near a $d$-dimensional manifold, the kernel mass grows like $\sigma^d$, so differentiating with respect to the noise scale reveals the intrinsic exponent. Under a regular manifold model, we show uniformly over the model class that the finite-scale field differs from the manifold dimension $d$ by at most $O(\sigma^2)$. We then establish a minimax lower bound of order $(n\sigma^d)^{-1}$ for estimating this finite-scale field from $n$ observations, for $n^{-1/(2\alpha+d)}\lesssim\sigma\le\sigma_0$. At the smallest scale covered by our lower-bound construction, the bound becomes the nonparametric rate $n^{-2\alpha/(2\alpha+d)}$.
summary_zh: 近年来基于扩散的方法已经成为探测高维数据内在几何结构的有效工具，但其统计层面的求解难度仍鲜有研究。本文研究FLIPD（Kamkari等，2024；arXiv:2406.03537）背后的有限尺度总体泛函的估计问题，FLIPD是一种基于扩散的局部本征维度（LID）指标，通过高斯平滑密度的对数尺度导数定义。直观上，高斯平滑将局部维度转化为尺度定律：在d维流形附近，核质量的增长规律为σ^d，因此对噪声尺度求导即可得到本征指数。在正则流形模型下，本文证明在整个模型类上，有限尺度场与流形维度d的差异不超过O(σ²)。随后针对n个观测样本，在n^{-1/(2α+d)} ≲ σ ≤ σ₀的条件下，本文建立了估计该有限尺度场的阶为(nσ^d)^{-1}的极小极大下界。在该下界构造覆盖的最小尺度下，下界变为阶为n^{-2α/(2α+d)}的非参数速率。

title: Federated Attack Campaign Detection via Contrastive Encoding of Threat Indicators in Gradient Updates
title_zh: 基于梯度更新中威胁指标对比编码的联邦攻击活动检测
authors: Manuel Röder, Bibin Babu, Frank-Michael Schleif
abstract: Detecting orchestrated cyberattack campaigns that span multiple organizations traditionally requires sharing sensitive telemetry and threat intelligence across institutional boundaries and country borders, a barrier that Federated Learning removes by training shared threat detectors directly on local data. We propose FedIoC, a modular framework in which clients fold locally available structured threat indicators into their gradient updates; we instantiate the client-side encoder with a supervised contrastive loss over IoC-matched flows. Within each training batch, flows that match any known indicator pattern form the positive set; the contrastive objective pulls their learned embeddings together and pushes non-IoC embeddings away, so that campaign-relevant structure is, by design, expressed in the gradient direction. Clients sharing indicators for the same attack campaign then produce aligned gradient components, which the server clusters by the cosine similarity of their updates to recover global campaign patterns without any direct IoC transmission. We evaluate FedIoC on two public threat-detection benchmarks distributed across FL clients that each observe only a fragment of every active campaign and hold disjoint indicator sets derived from their local telemetry. In this regime the FL server recovers cross-organizational campaign cohorts directly from gradient geometry. We contribute FedIoC as a modular framework for this setting, and use it to pinpoint the non-IID gradient structure as the main driver of recovery and to define the open problem of designing encoders that improve on it.
summary_zh: 检测跨多组织的协同网络攻击活动，传统方案需要跨机构和国家边界共享敏感遥测数据和威胁情报，而联邦学习可以直接在本地数据上训练共享威胁检测器，消除了这一障碍。本文提出FedIoC模块化框架，客户端将本地可用的结构化威胁指标整合到梯度更新中；客户端侧编码器针对匹配IoC（威胁指标）的流使用监督对比损失。在每个训练批次中，匹配任意已知指标模式的流构成正样本集，对比目标将其学习到的嵌入拉近，将非IoC嵌入推远，因此与攻击活动相关的结构会按照设计体现在梯度方向中。共享同一攻击活动指标的客户端会生成对齐的梯度分量，服务器通过更新的余弦相似度对其聚类，无需直接传输任何IoC即可恢复全局攻击活动模式。本文在两个分布于联邦学习客户端的公开威胁检测基准上评估FedIoC，每个客户端仅观测每个活跃攻击活动的片段，持有从本地遥测得到的互不重叠的指标集。在该场景下，联邦学习服务器可直接从梯度几何结构中恢复跨组织的攻击活动群组。本文将FedIoC作为该场景下的模块化框架开源，用其确定非独立同分布梯度结构是攻击活动恢复的主要驱动因素，并提出设计性能更优的编码器这一开放问题。

title: How Faithful Is Attribution for Sales Forecasting? A Counterfactual Study
title_zh: 销售预测中归因方法的可信度如何？一项反事实研究
authors: Glib Kechyn
abstract: Deep models for sales forecasting, such as WaveNet-style dilated convolutional networks, are accurate but opaque: when a single model predicts sales for one of many series, it offers no account of why. We add a post-hoc, architecture-agnostic counterfactual interpretability layer to a multi-series WaveNet forecaster trained on the full Corporacion Favorita grocery dataset (174,685 series over 1,688 days). The method decomposes each forecast into contributions that sum exactly to the predicted value, avoiding the allocation artifacts we observed with additive SHAP-style attribution. We evaluate faithfulness with a deletion/insertion protocol and find a statistically significant effect on both tests (deletion gap 0.22, p<0.001; insertion gap 0.27, p<0.01; robust across five background-sampling seeds), establishing that the attributions reflect genuine model behavior rather than plausible-looking artifacts. We then characterize, honestly, where attribution is and is not informative: reliance on the promotion signal is heterogeneous across series (median ratio approximately 1.0, with roughly 20% of series showing a strong effect), and the model captures the shape of the weekly sales cycle (day-of-week r=0.78) while systematically under-predicting its amplitude. Our contribution is not improved accuracy but an interpretability layer with a rigorous faithfulness evaluation and a candid account of its limits.
summary_zh: 基于深度模型的销售预测（例如WaveNet风格的空洞卷积网络）精度高但可解释性差：当单个模型预测大量序列中某一个的销量时，无法给出预测依据。本文在基于完整Corporacion Favorita杂货数据集（覆盖1688天共174685个序列）训练的多序列WaveNet预测器上添加了与架构无关的事后反事实可解释层。该方法将每个预测分解为多个贡献项，所有贡献项之和严格等于预测值，避免了在加性SHAP风格归因中观察到的分配伪影。本文使用删除/插入协议评估归因可信度，两项测试均得到统计显著结果（删除间隙0.22，p<0.001；插入间隙0.27，p<0.01；在5个背景采样种子下均保持鲁棒），证明归因结果反映的是模型真实行为而非看似合理的伪影。随后本文客观描述了归因方法的有效和无效场景：不同序列对促销信号的依赖程度存在异质性（中位数比率约为1.0，约20%的序列表现出强效应），模型捕捉到了周度销售周期的形态（星期几相关系数r=0.78），但系统性低估其振幅。本文的贡献不是提升预测精度，而是提出了具备严格可信度评估的可解释层，并客观说明了其局限性。

title: Learning-Augmented Algorithms: Guarantees, Construction Mechanisms, and System-Level Implications
title_zh: 学习增强型算法：性能保证、构建机制与系统级影响
authors: Hailiang Zhao, Xueyan Tang, Peng Chen, Zenong Ye, Tianjun Zhu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Learning-augmented algorithms use fallible predictions while retaining formal performance guarantees. This survey synthesizes prediction interfaces, error measures, consistency--robustness trade-offs, and five representative construction mechanisms across online optimization, caching, learned data structures, graph problems, and mechanism design. An orthogonal theorem-level axis distinguishes achieved upper bounds from matched asymptotic dependence. Formal guarantees are separated from empirical systems evidence, with explicit treatment of prediction cost, feedback, and composition. The resulting synthesis states sufficient conditions for limited end-to-end reasoning and delineates open problems in cost-aware prediction, endogenous error, semantic predictors, and benchmarking.
summary_zh: 学习增强型算法使用存在误差的预测，同时保留形式化的性能保证。本综述梳理了覆盖在线优化、缓存、学习型数据结构、图问题和机制设计领域的预测接口、误差度量、一致性-鲁棒性权衡以及5种代表性构建机制。在定理层面的独立维度上，本文区分了已实现的上界和匹配的渐近依赖关系，将形式化保证与经验系统证据分开阐述，明确讨论了预测成本、反馈和组合性问题。最终的综述总结了端到端推理受限的充分条件，并明确了感知成本预测、内生误差、语义预测器和基准测试方向的开放问题。

title: A Robust Watermark-based Fingerprint Framework for GNNs Ownership Verification
title_zh: 面向图神经网络（GNN）所有权验证的鲁棒水印指纹框架
authors: Han Zhang, Yan Wang, Guanfeng Liu, Pengfei Ding, Huaxiong Wang 等 (6 人)
abstract: The high training cost of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) has raised growing concerns regarding model ownership infringement, such as model stealing and unauthorized misuse. To verify model ownership and prevent significant economic losses, two groups of GNN Ownership Verification (OV) methods have been proposed: watermark-based methods and fingerprint-based methods. However, these methods typically face three limitations: (1) the performance degradation of protected models caused by out-of-distribution (OOD) watermark graphs with respect to the training set; (2) the unrealistic assumption that surrogate models have been trained on a watermark-containing training set; and (3) over-reliance on specific output levels for fingerprint extraction. In this paper, we propose a Robust watErMArk-based fingeRprint frameworK for GNNs, named REMARK. REMARK first generates carefully crafted in-distribution watermark graphs that maximize output differences between GNN models, thus mitigating OOD-induced performance degradation. REMARK then extracts robust fingerprints from these output differences to verify GNN ownership, thereby removing the assumptions that surrogate models must be trained on a watermark-containing dataset or expose specific output levels. Extensive experiments across widely used real-world datasets and GNN architectures demonstrate that REMARK achieves state-of-the-art OV accuracy and robustness while preserving the utility of protected models.
summary_zh: 图神经网络（GNN）高昂的训练成本引发了学界对模型窃取、未授权滥用等模型所有权侵权问题的广泛关注。为验证模型所有权、避免重大经济损失，目前已提出两类GNN所有权验证（OV）方法：基于水印的方法和基于指纹的方法。但现有方法普遍存在三点局限：（1）相对于训练集的分布外（OOD）水印图会导致受保护模型的性能下降；（2）替代模型必须在含水印训练集上训练的假设不符合现实场景；（3）指纹提取过程过度依赖特定输出层级。本文提出面向GNN的鲁棒水印指纹框架REMARK，该方法首先生成精心设计的分布内水印图，最大化不同GNN模型之间的输出差异，缓解分布外样本引发的性能退化；随后从上述输出差异中提取鲁棒指纹完成GNN所有权验证，无需满足替代模型必须在含水印数据集上训练、或暴露特定输出层级的前置假设。在主流真实数据集和GNN架构上开展的大量实验表明，REMARK在保障受保护模型可用性的同时，实现了当前最优的所有权验证精度与鲁棒性。

title: Resilience Beyond Stationary Client Unavailability: Unlocking Efficient and Unbiased Federated Learning
title_zh: 超越静态客户端不可用性的弹性：解锁高效无偏联邦学习
authors: Ming Xiang, Stratis Ioannidis, Edmund Yeh, Carlee Joe-Wong, Lili Su
abstract: Due to resource constraints or external and internal uncertainties, clients in real-world federated learning systems are often intermittently available edge devices. In highly dynamic environments, the parameter server lacks prior real-time knowledge of clients' availability, making it challenging to adapt traditional federated learning algorithms to be resilient to uncertainties in client availability. If not carefully addressed, complex client availability can introduce significant bias, potentially harming the performance of the trained model. Most prior work either fails to account for non-stationary client availability dynamics or demands significant memory and computational overhead. This paper aims to develop efficient federated learning algorithms that are provably resilient to heterogeneous and non-stationary stochastic client availability. We propose FedSWE, which admits novel algorithmic structures to (i) compensate for missed computations, (ii) stabilize and diffuse the global updates over rounds, and (iii) evenly mix the local updates through implicit gossiping, despite being agnostic to non-stationary dynamics. Compared with the standard FedAvg, FedSWE introduces light additional memory and computation overhead. We show that FedSWE converges to a stationary point of non-convex objectives while achieving the desired linear speedup property in certain special cases. We corroborate our analysis with numerical experiments over diversified client unavailability dynamics on real-world data sets.
summary_zh: 受资源约束或内外部不确定性影响，现实联邦学习系统中的客户端通常是间歇性可用的边缘设备。在高度动态的环境中，参数服务器无法预先实时掌握客户端的可用状态，传统联邦学习算法很难适配客户端可用性的不确定性。如果处理不当，复杂的客户端可用性模式会引入显著偏差，损害训练后模型的性能。现有相关工作大多要么未考虑非平稳的客户端可用性动态，要么需要极高的内存与计算开销。本文旨在开发可证明对异构非平稳随机客户端可用性具备弹性的高效联邦学习算法，提出FedSWE算法，其采用全新的算法结构：（1）补偿缺失的计算量；（2）在多轮迭代中稳定并扩散全局更新；（3）通过隐式闲聊机制均匀混合本地更新，且算法本身无需感知非平稳动态。与标准FedAvg（联邦平均算法）相比，FedSWE仅引入了极低的额外内存与计算开销。理论证明FedSWE可收敛到非凸目标的驻点，且在部分特殊场景下可实现理想的线性加速特性。我们在真实数据集上针对多样化的客户端不可用动态开展数值实验，验证了理论分析的结论。

title: A Fairness Audit of the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern Method: Format-Specific and Gender-Differential Bias, with an Interpretable Calibration Layer for Cricket Target Revision
title_zh: Duckworth-Lewis-Stern（DLS）方法的公平性审计：特定赛制偏差与性别差异偏差及用于板球目标分数修正的可解释校准层
authors: Soumyadeep Roy
abstract: The Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method has been the international standard for revising target scores in rain-interrupted limited-overs cricket since 1999. Despite over two decades of operational use, no large-scale empirical audit of its prediction bias has been published. We conduct such an audit on 8,150 international matches (3,095 ODIs, 5,055 T20Is) from Cricsheet, generating 233,550 synthetic interruption scenarios with temporal splits. We document two structured biases. First, DLS prediction error spans a 137-run range across (overs-remaining, wickets-lost) match-state buckets. Second, DLS exhibits a gender-differential bias on ODIs that has not previously been quantified: on the training split, mean over-prediction is +1.51 runs for men but +7.63 runs for women, a gap of +6.13 runs (F = 195.16, p < 10^-43). We benchmark DLS against five modern alternatives: Bi-LSTM, XGBoost, an enriched XGBoost variant, a deep context-aware model, and a stacking ensemble, and propose DLS-Cal, a lightweight interpretable calibration layer (27K parameters) outputting a state-conditioned correction added to DLS. DLS-Cal reduces absolute bias by 31% on ODI and 19% on T20I, and a gender-aware variant reduces women's ODI residual bias from +6.19 to +0.65 runs while leaving men's calibration unchanged. We release code, models, and data.
summary_zh: 自1999年以来，Duckworth-Lewis-Stern（DLS）方法一直是雨中断的有限回合板球赛事中修正目标得分的国际标准。尽管该方法已投入实际使用二十余年，目前仍没有公开的大规模实证审计工作评估其预测偏差。本文基于Cricsheet平台的8150场国际板球赛事数据（包含3095场一日国际板球赛ODI、5055场20回合国际板球赛T20I）开展审计，通过时序拆分生成233550个合成中断场景，发现两类结构性偏差：第一，DLS的预测误差在不同（剩余回合数、已失三柱门数）赛事状态分组下的差值可达137分；第二，DLS在ODI赛事中存在此前未被量化的性别差异偏差：训练集上男性赛事的平均预测高估为+1.51分，女性赛事为+7.63分，差值达+6.13分（F=195.16，p<10^-43）。我们将DLS与5种现代替代方法（Bi-LSTM、XGBoost、增强版XGBoost、深度上下文感知模型、堆叠集成模型）进行基准对比，并提出轻量化可解释校准层DLS-Cal（仅27K参数），输出与赛事状态相关的修正值叠加到DLS的原始结果上。DLS-Cal可将ODI赛事的绝对偏差降低31%，T20I赛事的绝对偏差降低19%；其中性别感知版本可将女性ODI赛事的残差偏差从+6.19分降至+0.65分，同时不影响男性赛事的校准效果。本文已开源相关代码、模型与数据集。

title: Same Request, Different Answer: Quantization Amplifies Cache-Induced Divergence in LLM Serving
title_zh: 相同请求，不同答案：量化放大大语言模型服务中缓存引发的结果分歧
authors: Aditi Patodiya
abstract: Prefix caching, in which a serving engine reuses the key and value tensors of a shared prompt prefix across requests, is enabled by default in the major open-source stacks and treated as a transparent optimization. We measure what it costs in reproducibility, and find that the cost rises sharply with weight quantization. Holding the model, decoding parameters, seed, and request order fixed, and issuing every request serially at batch size one, we ran an eighty-episode multi-turn agentic tool-use workload with caching enabled and disabled across two engines and four weight formats. Enabling the cache changed the agent's trajectory on 36.2 percent of episodes at 16-bit precision and on 75.0 percent at four-bit, a gradient that survives re-measurement under a controlled cache configuration. With caching disabled, repeated execution was bit-identical in every configuration, 0 of 800 episodes, which bounds other sources of nondeterminism at 0.5 percent. Repeated cache-enabled runs did diverge, and three experiments locate the cause: a single server-level prompt-cache setting moves run-to-run divergence by 37.5 percentage points, execution order acts only while that setting is active, and restoring cache state makes the cached and recompute paths each reproduce on 40 of 40 items while still differing from each other on 14. Cached serving is deterministic given cache state, and irreproducible in practice because that state is absent from the request and never reset by default. A single-turn bridge shows the divergence reaching task outcomes without shifting aggregate accuracy. We release the harness, logs, and analysis pipeline.
summary_zh: 前缀缓存是指服务引擎跨请求复用共享提示前缀的键值张量，目前主流开源大语言模型服务栈默认启用该机制，将其作为透明优化手段。本文测量了前缀缓存在可复现性层面的代价，发现该代价会随权重量化程度提升急剧上升。我们固定模型、解码参数、随机种子与请求顺序，以批量大小为1串行发送所有请求，在2个引擎、4种权重格式下运行80轮多轮智能体工具调用工作负载，分别开启和关闭缓存：16位精度下开启缓存会改变36.2%轮次的智能体运行轨迹，4位精度下该比例升至75.0%，该趋势在受控缓存配置下重复测量依然成立。关闭缓存时，所有配置下的重复执行结果完全比特一致，800轮测试中未出现分歧，说明其他非确定性来源的占比不超过0.5%。开启缓存的重复运行确实会出现分歧，三组实验定位了分歧成因：单个服务器级提示缓存设置可将运行间分歧率改变37.5个百分点，执行顺序仅在该设置激活时才会产生影响，恢复缓存状态后缓存路径与重计算路径各自的40个样本均可完全复现，但两条路径的结果仍有14个样本存在差异。给定缓存状态时缓存服务是确定性的，但实际场景中缓存状态不包含在请求参数内且默认不会重置，因此服务结果不可复现。单轮桥接实验表明，该分歧会影响任务最终结果，但不会改变整体聚合精度。本文已开源测试框架、日志与分析流水线。

title: Training Large Language Models for Small-Molecule Design with Synthetic Task Scaling
title_zh: 面向小分子设计的合成任务缩放训练大语言模型
authors: Frank Hu, Shriram Chennakesavalu, Zichen Wang, Patricia Suriana, Bodhi Vani 等 (8 人)
abstract: Designing viable drug candidates requires searching a combinatorially large and rugged chemical space for molecules that satisfy multiple, often competing, objectives. Large language models (LLMs) provide a useful generative prior for this problem because of their representational capacity, reasoning ability, and flexibility when incorporating information from the external environment. While reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) can be used to improve the capabilities of LLMs, many chemically relevant scoring functions require hours or even days per evaluation, making them prohibitively expensive to use directly during online training. Here, we investigate whether LLMs can learn molecular design strategies from cheaper synthetic tasks that generalize to expensive molecular lead optimization settings. We find that curriculum-based training recipes that gradually incorporate more challenging synthetic design tasks enable strong performance that surpasses that of much larger frontier models on structure-based lead optimization. Our results suggest that scaling post-training using synthetic tasks is an effective strategy for adapting LLMs to high-cost experimental scenarios that are too expensive to directly train on.
summary_zh: 设计可行的药物候选分子需要在组合空间极大、崎岖度极高的化学空间中搜索满足多个往往相互冲突的目标的分子。大语言模型（LLM）凭借其强大的表征能力、推理能力以及整合外部环境信息的灵活性，为该问题提供了有效的生成先验。虽然可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）可用于提升大语言模型的能力，但大量化学相关的评分函数单次评估就需要数小时甚至数天，直接在在线训练中使用这类函数的成本高到无法承受。本文研究大语言模型能否从成本更低的合成任务中学习分子设计策略，泛化到成本高昂的分子先导优化场景。研究发现，采用逐步引入更具挑战性的合成设计任务的课程训练方案，可实现远超规模大得多的前沿模型的基于结构的先导优化性能。研究结果表明，基于合成任务的后训练缩放是将大语言模型适配到高成本实验场景的有效策略，这类场景的直接训练成本过高，无法直接开展训练。

title: Locating and Steering Refusal Beyond Attention
title_zh: 注意力之外的拒绝行为定位与引导
authors: Preethi Carmel Bosco, Gopalakrishnan Srinivasan
abstract: Where inside a language model does refusal live, and does that place change when the architecture does? In a transformer, refusal is governed by a single direction in the residual stream, a finding that safety and interpretability tooling now depend on. State-space models (SSMs) route information through a recurrent update instead of attention, sharing no token-mixing mechanism with a transformer. Does the same safety representation survive this shift, or must it be rediscovered per architecture? It survives. A single rigid rotation, which can only reorient a space and not reshape it, aligns one model's representation space with another's, so the two genuinely share the representation. A harm probe trained on a transformer then flags an SSM's harmful inputs, and removing the aligned direction makes a model answer attacks it would otherwise refuse, while a random direction of the same size does far less. What is architecture-specific is not where the direction is steered but where it must be read. Each layer computes a fresh output that is then added into the residual stream, and harm is cleanly readable at this output, the write site, before the addition. A control that holds the intervention's strength fixed shows that what matters is where the direction is estimated, not where it is applied. Applied through a detector-triggered gate, this direction lowers jailbreak success in all four architecture families we test (SSM, transformer, recurrent, hybrid), and on the SSM it holds against an attacker that tunes its prompt against the defense. The gate only matches a trivial rule that returns a fixed refusal whenever the same detector fires, so what transfers across architectures is the direction itself, not defense strength. Safety tooling built on refusal therefore ports to a new architecture by re-estimating the direction at that architecture's write site, not by rebuilding it.
summary_zh: 语言模型内部的拒绝行为存储在什么位置？该位置是否会随模型架构变化而改变？在Transformer架构中，拒绝行为由残差流中的单个方向控制，这一结论是当前安全与可解释性工具的核心基础。状态空间模型（SSM）通过循环更新而非注意力机制路由信息，不存在Transformer的token混合机制，那么相同的安全表征是否能在架构切换后保留，还是需要针对每个架构重新发现？本文证明该表征可以跨架构保留：单个刚性旋转（仅能重新定向空间而不会重塑空间）即可对齐两个模型的表征空间，说明二者确实共享该表征。在Transformer上训练的危害探针可以识别SSM的有害输入，移除对齐后的方向可让模型回答原本会拒绝的攻击，而相同大小的随机方向几乎不会产生该效果。架构相关的部分不是该方向的引导位置，而是该方向的读取位置：每一层计算得到的新输出会被加到残差流中，在相加前的写入点位置可以清晰读取到危害相关信息。控制干预强度固定的对照实验表明，关键因素是方向的估计位置，而非方向的应用位置。通过检测器触发的门控机制应用该方向后，可降低测试的四类架构家族（SSM、Transformer、循环架构、混合架构）的越狱成功率，且在SSM上可抵御针对防御机制调整提示的攻击者。该门控仅遵循简单规则：同一检测器触发时返回固定拒绝，说明跨架构迁移的是方向本身，而非防御强度。因此基于拒绝行为构建的安全工具无需完全重建，仅需在新架构的写入点重新估计该方向即可完成迁移。

title: A Differentiable Neural Surrogate for Photon Propagation in Neutrino Telescopes
title_zh: 中微子望远镜中光子传播的可微神经代理模型
authors: Felix J. Yu, Berthy T. Feng, Nicholas Kamp, Carlos A. Argüelles
abstract: Large-volume neutrino telescopes infer neutrino properties from Cherenkov light, but simulating the transport of billions of photons through highly scattering ice or water is computationally costly. We introduce candela, a differentiable SIREN neural field that learns the photon Green's function of the IceCube Neutrino Observatory, a cubic-kilometer detector embedded in Antarctic glacial ice. Given a point-like energy deposit and sensor, it predicts the expected photon yield and full arrival-time distribution at the sensor. Complete events are simulated by decomposing charged-particle energy deposits into point-like sources and superposing their predicted sensor responses. Trained on Monte-Carlo simulations, candela generates events $50$--$100\times$ faster than existing methods, with cost scaling only weakly with neutrino energy. It keeps median yields within $2\%$ of the MC expectation and timing distributions at the MC statistical floor across six photon-count decades. The model also provides end-to-end gradients with respect to event parameters and opens a path toward optimizing scattering-medium properties, which often dominate systematic uncertainties in neutrino telescopes.
summary_zh: 大体积中微子望远镜通过切伦科夫光推断中微子属性，但模拟数十亿光子在高散射冰或水体中的输运过程计算成本极高。本文提出可微SIREN神经场candela，用于学习嵌入在南极冰川冰中的立方公里级探测器冰立方中微子天文台的光子格林函数。给定点性能量沉积位置与传感器，该模型可预测传感器处的预期光子产额与完整的光子到达时间分布。完整事件的模拟通过将带电粒子的能量沉积分解为点源，叠加各点源预测的传感器响应实现。在蒙特卡洛模拟数据上训练后，candela生成事件的速度比现有方法快50-100倍，且计算成本随中微子能量的增长非常平缓。该模型的中位数光子产额与蒙特卡洛预期值的偏差不超过2%，在跨越6个光子计数数量级的范围内，时间分布的精度达到蒙特卡洛统计误差下限。该模型还可输出事件参数的端到端梯度，为优化散射介质属性提供了新路径，而散射介质属性通常是中微子望远镜系统不确定性的主要来源。

title: WEECFP-SuRGE: Wide Embedded Extended Connectivity Fingerprint with Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding
title_zh: WEECFP-SuRGE：带亚结构旋转图距离编码的宽嵌入扩展连接性指纹
authors: Robert Epps
abstract: We introduce WEECFP, a parameter-free 1024-dimensional continuous molecular fingerprint that scatters each Morgan substructure across roughly thirty-two signed positions of a single vector, and WEECFP-SuRGE, a transformer architecture whose self-attention applies SuRGE (Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding) -- a RoPE-like rotation parameterized by molecular shortest-path graph distance -- to WEECFP substructure tokens. A 7-model blend of this architecture (the WEECFP-SuRGE Blend) achieves the lowest average regression rank on the TDC ADMET leaderboard; is #2 overall on the TDC ADMET leaderboard (behind only pretrained MapLight+GNN), and is #1 overall among methods that use no external pretraining; takes leaderboard #1 finishes on Pgp, Lipophilicity, CYP2D6 Substrate, Clearance Microsome, and LD50 (with the WEECFP-NoSuRGE Blend separately reaching #1 on HIA) across the full 22-benchmark suite -- without any external pretraining. On MoleculeNet, WEECFP-SuRGE beats every classical-fingerprint baseline on 3 of 4 regression tasks (ESOL, Lipophilicity, QM9). We further show that WEECFP tokenization is near-lossless: a greedy overlap reconstruction recovers the exact canonical SMILES of 99.9% of in-distribution molecules across 9 MoleculeNet datasets and 98.93% of molecules in a cross-dataset holdout (HIV->Lipophilicity), and that a three-reference farthest-first encoding of graph distance correlates at Pearson r = 0.901 with the true pairwise distance, enabling O(S) positional memory at matching accuracy.
summary_zh: 本文提出无参数的1024维连续分子指纹WEECFP，该指纹将每个Morgan亚结构分散映射到单个向量的约32个带符号位置上；同时提出Transformer架构WEECFP-SuRGE，其自注意力机制应用SuRGE（亚结构旋转图距离编码）——一种类似RoPE、由分子最短路径图距离参数化的旋转操作——处理WEECFP的亚结构token。由7个该架构模型融合得到的WEECFP-SuRGE融合模型在TDC ADMET排行榜上的平均回归排名最低，总榜位列第二（仅次于预训练的MapLight+GNN），在所有未使用外部预训练的方法中位列第一；在覆盖22个基准的全测试集上，该模型在Pgp、亲脂性、CYP2D6底物、微粒体清除率、LD50任务上取得排行榜第一，其中WEECFP-NoSuRGE融合模型单独在HIA任务上取得第一，全程未使用任何外部预训练。在MoleculeNet数据集上，WEECFP-SuRGE在4个回归任务中的3个（ESOL、亲脂性、QM9）上性能超过所有经典指纹基线。本文进一步证明WEECFP的token化过程接近无损：通过贪心重叠重建，在9个MoleculeNet数据集上可恢复99.9%分布内分子的精确规范SMILES，在跨数据集留出集（HIV->亲脂性）上的恢复率为98.93%；基于三个参考点的最远优先图距离编码与真实成对距离的皮尔逊相关系数r=0.901，可在匹配精度下实现O(S)级的位置内存开销。

title: Interpretability for Turing Machines
title_zh: 图灵机的可解释性研究
authors: Billy Snikkers, Rumi Salazar, Daniel Murfet, Will Troiani
abstract: We show that susceptibilities, an interpretability technique developed for neural networks, can identify the presence of algorithmic structure in Turing machines by probing the local loss landscape of a learning problem for noisy Turing machines introduced by Murfet and Troiani (arXiv:2504.08075). We prove that symmetries and path separation in the algorithm implemented by a Turing machine induce permutation symmetries and low-rank blocks in its susceptibility matrix. We study this empirically on a set of deterministic finite automata (DFAs) and demonstrate that algorithmic features can be recovered by principal component analysis and clustering methods in susceptibility space.
summary_zh: 本文证明，原本为神经网络开发的可解释性技术——敏感度方法，可通过探测Murfet和Troiani提出的带噪声图灵机学习问题的局部损失景观，识别图灵机中存在的算法结构。本文从理论上证明，图灵机实现的算法中存在的对称性与路径分离特性，会在其敏感度矩阵中诱导出排列对称性与低秩块结构。本文在一组确定有限自动机（DFA）上开展实证研究，证明在敏感度空间中通过主成分分析与聚类方法可恢复出算法特征。

title: SMILE: Bridging Continuous Optimization and Discrete Symbolic Recovery
title_zh: SMILE：打通连续优化与离散符号恢复的桥梁
authors: Mansooreh Montazerin, Antonio Ortega, Ajitesh Srivastava
abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) discovers closed-form mathematical expressions from data, offering interpretability beyond black-box models. Existing methods suffer from slow convergence in combinatorial search spaces and lack mechanisms to exploit compositional structure in the data. We introduce SMILE (Sine, Multiplication, Identity, Logarithm, Exponential), a hybrid framework that unifies continuous gradient-based optimization with discrete symbolic recovery through three stages: structural analysis of the data to identify the compositional hierarchy of the target expression, continuous optimization to learn parameters of a network that encodes the target expression using interpretable activations, and symbolic recovery through structured pruning, coefficient optimization, and rounding. This final stage distills the learned network into a compact expression with exact symbolic constants. We evaluate SMILE on SRBench across ground-truth and black-box datasets, with ablation studies validating each component. SMILE achieves the highest symbolic solution rate at the largest noise levels, demonstrating strong robustness where competing methods degrade substantially. It consistently lies on the Pareto front of accuracy versus complexity, recovering significantly simpler expressions in a fraction of the time required by the competing methods.
summary_zh: 符号回归（SR）可从数据中发现闭式数学表达式，提供黑盒模型无法实现的可解释性。现有方法在组合搜索空间中收敛速度慢，且缺乏利用数据中组合结构的机制。本文提出SMILE（Sine、Multiplication、Identity、Logarithm、Exponential的缩写）混合框架，通过三个阶段统一基于梯度的连续优化与离散符号恢复：第一阶段对数据开展结构分析，识别目标表达式的组合层级；第二阶段通过连续优化学习使用可解释激活函数编码目标表达式的网络参数；第三阶段通过结构化剪枝、系数优化与舍入操作完成符号恢复，将训练得到的网络蒸馏为带精确符号常数的紧凑表达式。本文在SRBench基准上基于真实表达式数据集与黑盒数据集开展评估，通过消融实验验证各组件的有效性。在高噪声场景下，SMILE的符号解生成率最高，在其他对比方法性能大幅下降的场景下仍保持强鲁棒性。该方法始终位于精度-复杂度的帕累托前沿，仅需对比方法的一小部分时间即可恢复出复杂度远更低的表达式。

title: Too Rare to Learn: Prescribed Cyclone Tracks Degrade a Bay of Bengal Ocean Emulator
title_zh: 过于罕见而无法学习：预设气旋轨迹会降低孟加拉湾海洋仿真器性能
authors: Sumaiya Islam
abstract: Neural ocean emulators are being proposed for regional forecasting in cyclone-exposed coastal seas, and a natural design choice is to hand the network the cyclone as a prescribed input. We test that choice in the Bay of Bengal and find it harmful. We withhold 15 whole cyclones spanning 65 to 150 kt from GLORYS12 reanalysis and compare two U-Nets that are identical except for four prescribed cyclone-track channels. Across three seeds the ocean-only model beats persistence in every run and the storm-conditioned model loses to it in every run, with the two skill ranges disjoint (p = 3.1e-5, paired across storms). The cause is exposure frequency rather than signal content: the channels are non-zero on only 7.9% of training days, so they are out of distribution the moment they activate. The extra error falls inside the prescribed storm footprint, and replacing the real cyclone map with a no-storm map at inference improves held-out storm forecasts by 7.5 to 16.4% in every seed. The conditioned network has learned a response to a rare signal that is confidently wrong.
summary_zh: 目前学界正提出面向受气旋影响沿海海域区域预报的神经海洋仿真器，一种常见的设计思路是将气旋作为预设输入提供给网络。本文在孟加拉湾场景下测试该思路，发现其反而会损害模型性能。研究从GLORYS12再分析数据集中预留了15个风速范围为65至150节的完整气旋事件，对比两个仅在4个预设气旋轨迹通道上存在差异的U-Net模型。在3个不同随机种子的实验中，仅输入海洋数据的模型在所有运行场景下的表现都优于持续性基准预测，而加入气旋条件的模型表现全部差于持续性基准，二者的性能取值范围完全不重叠（跨气旋配对检验p=3.1e-5）。该问题的根源是特征的暴露频率而非信号本身的信息含量：气旋轨迹通道在训练日中仅7.9%的时间取值非零，因此一旦该通道被激活，输入就处于分布外状态。额外的预测误差全部集中在预设的风暴影响范围内，在推理阶段将真实气旋图替换为无风暴图后，所有随机种子下的预留风暴预测精度都提升了7.5%至16.4%。加入气旋条件的网络学习到了对罕见信号的错误响应，且该响应的置信度极高。

title: GNN-Guided Graph Coarsening and Adaptive QUBO Penalties for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows on a Quantum Annealer
title_zh: 面向量子退火器求解带时间窗容量车辆路径问题的GNN（图神经网络）引导图粗化与自适应QUBO（二次无约束二元优化）惩罚机制
authors: Youssef Kamel Rezk, Paweł Gora
abstract: Graph coarsening reduces the large Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) formulations arising when vehicle-routing problems are solved by quantum annealing. Nearby customers with compatible time windows are merged into super-nodes, the reduced problem is solved, and the solution is expanded to the original graph. For the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW), existing coarsening heuristics require family-specific tuning and remain unreliable on random instances. We address these limitations on the Solomon benchmark using simulated annealing and a D-Wave Advantage2 processor.We first introduce adaptive penalty calibration. Uniform penalty scaling has little effect, whereas controlling the internal coefficient range substantially improves raw samples. Removing non-binding constraints, normalising binding ones, and scaling the remaining penalties reduces mean raw constraint violations from 33.0 to 0.06 at the same solver budget (p=3.7e-11, n=56). A variable-count-preserving control attributes this gain to conditioning rather than problem size.Second, we replace the hand-tuned merge score with a graph neural network (GNN) using one configuration across all families. At N=10, it achieves 100% feasibility across all Solomon families, including R-type (100% vs. 80% for the tuned heuristic). Across N=10,...,100, feasibility is 83% vs. 69%, with the GNN better or tied on 85/90 instance-size pairs. At N=80,100, the difference is significant (p=0.002; 25/25 pairs), while the QUBO remains approximately 5-6 times smaller.Finally, hardware experiments reproduce the conditioning effect at fixed logical variable count: feasible samples increase from 0.02% to 39% across 13 instances. Classical repair with local search remains a reference bound for end-to-end solution cost.
summary_zh: 图粗化技术可缩小使用量子退火求解车辆路径问题时生成的大规模二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题规模。该技术将时间窗口兼容的邻近客户合并为超节点，求解降维后的小规模问题后再将解映射回原始图。针对带时间窗的容量车辆路径问题（CVRPTW），现有粗化启发式算法需要针对特定问题族做参数调优，在随机实例上的可靠性仍不足。本文使用模拟退火和D-Wave Advantage2处理器，在Solomon基准集上解决上述局限性。首先提出自适应惩罚校准方法：统一的惩罚缩放几乎没有效果，而控制内部系数范围可大幅提升原始采样质量。移除非绑定约束、归一化绑定约束并缩放剩余惩罚项后，在相同求解器算力预算下，平均原始约束违反率从33.0降至0.06（p=3.7e-11，n=56）。变量数保持不变的对照组实验证明该性能提升来自约束条件优化而非问题规模缩小。其次，使用图神经网络（GNN）替代人工调优的合并得分函数，仅用一套配置即可适配所有问题族。在客户规模N=10的场景下，该方法在所有Solomon问题族上都实现了100%的可行性，其中R型问题的可行性为100%，而调优后的启发式算法仅为80%。在N=10到N=100的范围内，该方法的整体可行性为83%，优于启发式算法的69%，且在90组实例规模配对中，GNN方法性能更优或持平的占比达85组。在N=80和N=100场景下二者差异显著（p=0.002，25组配对全部GNN占优），且处理后的QUBO问题规模仍比原始问题小5-6倍左右。最后硬件实验在固定逻辑变量数下复现了约束优化的效果：13个实例的可行采样占比从0.02%提升至39%。结合局部搜索的经典修复方法仍是端到端求解成本的参考基准。

title: Representation Redundancy and Structural Complexity in Finite-Field Inversion
title_zh: 有限域求逆中的表示冗余与结构复杂性
authors: Zheng Zhang, Na Zhang
abstract: The representation chosen for a mathematical operation can affect both its algebraic form and its empirical learning difficulty. We study this phenomenon for inversion over \(\mathbb F_{2^n}\), with field elements expressed in varying ordered \(\mathbb F_2\)-bases. We prove that two ordered bases induce the same coordinate inversion map if and only if they belong to the same Galois orbit. Since every orbit has size \(n\), the correspondence between ordered bases and distinct inversion maps is exactly \(n\)-to-one. We then analyze three Boolean formulations of inversion. The reference formulation has algebraic degree \(n-1\) and joint ANF leap \(1\), the mixed representation formulation has degree \(2(n-1)\) and joint ANF leap \(2\), and the complete raw formulation has degree at most \(3(n-1)\) and joint ANF leap at least \(n\). Exhaustive computations agree with the theoretical results and bounds in the cases considered. Controlled experiments with multilayer perceptrons show the same ordering in learning difficulty, while Galois orbit redundancy provides only a limited generalization benefit under the tested conditions. These results show that exact redundancy among representations can coexist with changes in Boolean structure and learning behavior when the representation is exposed as part of the input.
summary_zh: 数学运算选择的表示方式会同时影响其代数形式和经验学习难度。本文研究有限域F_{2^n}上的求逆运算该特性，其中域元素采用不同的有序F_2基表示。本文证明两个有序基诱导出相同的坐标求逆映射，当且仅当二者属于同一个伽罗瓦轨道。由于每个轨道的大小为n，有序基与不同求逆映射之间恰好是n对1的对应关系。随后本文分析了求逆运算的三种布尔表示：参考表示的代数次数为n-1，联合代数正规型（ANF）跳度为1；混合表示的代数次数为2(n-1)，联合ANF跳度为2；完整原始表示的代数次数不超过3(n-1)，联合ANF跳度至少为n。穷尽计算结果与所考虑场景下的理论结论和边界值完全吻合。使用多层感知机的对照实验显示三种表示的学习难度排序与理论推导一致，而伽罗瓦轨道冗余在测试条件下仅能带来有限的泛化增益。上述结果表明，当表示作为输入的一部分暴露给模型时，不同表示间的精确冗余可与布尔结构、学习行为的变化共存。

title: Centered Permutation Prefixes for SGD with Random Reshuffling: Sharp Rates, Hölder Geometry, and Composite Proximal Extensions
title_zh: 面向随机重排SGD的中心化排列前缀：紧速率界、赫尔德几何与复合近端扩展
authors: Jiaxiang Li
abstract:
We study stochastic gradient descent with random reshuffling for finite sums \[ F(x)= rac1n\sum_{i=1}^n f_i(x). \] For fresh reshuffling with a constant component stepsize, if each $f_i$ has an $L$-Lipschitz gradient and the average $F$ is $\mu$-strongly convex with a Lipschitz-continuous Hessian, we prove the last-epoch rate \[ \mathbb E[F(y_K)-F(x_\star)] =\widetilde O\!\left(T^{-2}+n^2T^{-3}ight), \qquad T=nK, \] matching the known quadratic lower bound in its $(n,K)$-dependence. The components may be nonconvex, and no componentwise Hessian continuity or separate bounded-iterate assumption is required. More generally, a $
u$-Hölder-continuous average Hessian adds only $\widetilde O(n^{1+
u}T^{-2-2
u})$, so every $
u\ge 1/2$ preserves the quadratic rate. Under convex components, a decreasing-stepsize result removes the large-epoch requirement and recovers the same two-term scale once $nK$ exceeds the condition-number scale.We also analyze epoch-wise ProxRR for $\mathcal P=F+\psi$. Writing $x^\dagger$ for the composite minimizer and $ eta_\star=\|
abla F(x^\dagger)\|$, we prove \[ \mathbb E\|y_K-x^\dagger\|^2 =\widetilde O\!\left(  rac{ eta_\star^2}{K^2} +T^{-2}+n^2T^{-3} +n^{1+
u}T^{-2-2
u} ight). \] For $
u\ge 1/2$, we show that the $ eta_\star^2/K^2$ splitting term is unavoidable and obtain a matching lower bound up to logarithms in the stated constant-stepsize regime.
summary_zh: 本文针对有限和形式的目标函数F(x)=(1/n)∑_{i=1}^n f_i(x)，研究带随机重排的随机梯度下降（SGD）算法。对于采用恒定分量步长的全新重排策略，若每个f_i的梯度是L-利普希茨连续的，且总目标函数F是μ-强凸的、同时具有利普希茨连续的海森矩阵，本文证明最后一轮迭代的收敛速率为E[F(y_K)-F(x_⋆)] = Õ(T^{-2}+n^2T^{-3})，其中T=nK，该结果在(n,K)依赖关系上与已知的二次下界完全匹配。各分量函数可以是非凸的，且不需要分量海森连续或单独的有界迭代假设。更一般地，若总目标函数的海森是ν-赫尔德连续的，仅会额外增加Õ(n^{1+ν}T^{-2-2ν})的误差项，因此所有ν≥1/2的场景都能保持二次收敛速率。在分量函数为凸的条件下，变步长结果消除了大迭代轮次要求，当nK超过条件数阈值后仍可得到相同的两项式误差规模。本文进一步针对复合目标P=F+ψ分析了按轮次执行的ProxRR算法，记复合极小值点为x^†，β_⋆=∥∇F(x^†)∥，证明收敛速率为E∥y_K-x^†∥^2 = Õ( β_⋆²/K² + T^{-2} + n²T^{-3} + n^{1+ν}T^{-2-2ν} )。对于ν≥1/2的场景，本文证明β_⋆²/K²这一分裂项是不可避免的，在恒定步长设定下得到了对数因子范围内匹配的下界。

title: Optimizer Memory Schedules for Outscaling the Overtraining Axis
title_zh: 优化器内存调度方案以突破过度训练轴的性能上限
authors: Katie Everett, Shikai Qiu
abstract: We investigate how optimizers scale across the overtraining axis and show that relative optimizer performance and optimal hyperparameters change substantially with training horizon. In particular, we study how matrix-preconditioned methods (Muon and SOAP) and a momentum-scheduled method (ADANA) scale relative to AdamW. We compare these four optimizers across models from 51M to 253M parameters and overtraining (OT) factors from 1x to 256x, sweeping the base learning rate at every setting. The preferred learning rate schedule can reverse across the overtraining axis, the best weight decay coefficient scales approximately as sqrt(OT), and longer horizons generally favor longer fixed memory. ADANA's scaling advantage over AdamW persists after tuning AdamW's fixed memory separately at each horizon. Log-time weight decay and momentum cooldown provide substantial gains for ADANA that compound as training increases. With this treatment, ADANA outscales AdamW with an exponent advantage close to that predicted by DANA theory on power-law random features. Muon and SOAP instead provide roughly constant token-efficiency advantages over AdamW across most of the measured range, although SOAP may gain further at the highest overtraining factors. ADANA begins behind both matrix-preconditioned optimizers but closes the gaps as training increases, surpassing Muon and becoming competitive with SOAP at our highest OT factors. These results establish training horizon as an essential axis for optimizer evaluation and design.
summary_zh: 本文研究优化器在过度训练轴上的缩放特性，发现优化器的相对性能和最优超参数会随训练时长发生显著变化。重点对比矩阵预条件方法（Muon和SOAP）、动量调度方法（ADANA）相对于AdamW的缩放表现。在参数量51M到253M的模型、1倍到256倍的过度训练（OT）因子范围内对四种优化器开展对比实验，在每个配置下遍历基础学习率。结果显示，最优学习率调度策略在过度训练轴上可能发生反转，最优权重衰减系数近似与√OT成正比，更长的训练时长通常倾向于使用更长的固定内存窗口。即使在每个训练时长下单独调优AdamW的固定内存参数，ADANA相对于AdamW的缩放优势仍然存在。对数时间权重衰减和动量冷却机制为ADANA带来了显著增益，且该增益会随训练推进不断累积。加入该机制后，ADANA的缩放指数优势接近幂律随机特征下DANA理论的预测结果，性能表现超过AdamW。相比之下，Muon和SOAP在大部分测试范围内相对于AdamW的token效率优势近似为常数，不过SOAP在最高过度训练因子下可能获得进一步增益。ADANA在训练初期的表现弱于两种矩阵预条件优化器，但随着训练推进差距不断缩小，在最高过度训练因子下性能超过Muon，且与SOAP的表现相当。上述结果表明训练时长是优化器评估与设计必须考虑的核心维度。

title: MURAL: Multimodal Uncertainty-aware Recommendation via Adaptive edge Learning
title_zh: MURAL：基于自适应边学习的多模态不确定性感知推荐
authors: Ahmad Mousavi, Majid Alikhani, Yeon-Chang Lee, Roberto Corizzo, Yeganeh Abdollahinejad
abstract: Multimodal Graph Neural Networks have become standard for recommendation by augmenting sparse interaction data with content features. Yet current architectures face two bottlenecks: structural rigidity, from a reliance on static precomputed similarity graphs that cannot adapt to evolving preferences; and semantic fragility, where noisy modality signals are indiscriminately fused, distorting the collaborative signal. We propose MURAL (Multimodal Uncertainty-aware Recommendation via Adaptive edge Learning), a unified framework that shifts multimodal recommendation from fixed structural augmentation to dynamic topology discovery. To address structural rigidity, an Adaptive Edge Learner combines a differentiable retrieval-augmented strategy with an approximate nearest neighbor search to discover latent item-item correlations that are both semantically adaptive and computationally scalable (O(NlogN)). To address semantic fragility, an Uncertainty-Aware Fusion module models the aleatoric uncertainty of heterogeneous modalities, dynamically down-weighting unreliable features while prioritizing high-confidence signals as a defense against cross-modal noise. We further employ a contrastive teacher-student alignment that anchors modality-specific representations to stable behavioral signals, ensuring optimization stability without gradient leakage. Experiments on large-scale benchmarks including TikTok and Amazon show that MURAL significantly surpasses both structural and generative state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior accuracy while offering interpretability through domain-specific modality dominance and robustness under extreme data corruption.
summary_zh: 多模态图神经网络通过向稀疏交互数据补充内容特征，已成为推荐系统的主流方案。但现有架构存在两个瓶颈：一是结构刚性，依赖静态预计算的相似度图，无法适应用户不断演化的偏好；二是语义脆弱性，无差别融合含噪的模态信号，会扭曲协同信号。本文提出MURAL（Multimodal Uncertainty-aware Recommendation via Adaptive edge Learning，基于自适应边学习的多模态不确定性感知推荐）统一框架，将多模态推荐从固定结构增强范式转向动态拓扑发现范式。针对结构刚性问题，自适应边学习器结合可微检索增强策略与近似最近邻搜索，可发现语义自适应且计算复杂度为O(NlogN)的潜在物品-物品关联。针对语义脆弱性问题，不确定性感知融合模块对异质模态的任意不确定性建模，动态降低不可靠特征的权重，同时优先分配高置信度信号权重，抵御跨模态噪声。本文进一步采用对比师生对齐机制，将模态专属表示锚定到稳定的行为信号上，在不发生梯度泄漏的前提下保证优化稳定性。在TikTok、Amazon等大规模基准集上的实验表明，MURAL的性能显著超过现有结构类和生成类的最优基线，不仅预测精度更高，还可通过领域专属的模态优先级提供可解释性，且在极端数据损坏场景下具备强鲁棒性。

title: A Sim-to-Real Study of Surface-Code Decoder Benchmarking
title_zh: 表面码解码器基准测试的仿真到真实硬件迁移研究
authors: Shay J. Manor, Leila S. Erhili, Yassine Jebbouri
abstract: Quantum error-correction decoders are typically benchmarked against synthetic circuit-level noise, under the assumption that a decoder's ranking under such noise transfers to hardware and improves as the noise model becomes more realistic. The Willow processor, the first to operate below the surface-code threshold, allows us to test this assumption. We rank a panel of six decoders using a four-rung ladder of noise models with increasing fidelity, evaluated against real data across three code distances, two bases, and fifteen round counts. Rank agreement with hardware appears once the noise model gives each operation type its own error rate. Calibrating the model to the device improves absolute error rates but not rank agreement. We additionally provide the first independent evaluation of NVIDIA's Ising pre-decoder on hardware, at code distances below its training receptive field and via a mapping onto the lattice on which it was trained. Under these conditions, it holds no accuracy-latency advantage: another panel decoder matches or improves on it in both per-cycle error rate and decode latency in 278 of the 280 evaluations. We release the full pipeline and the per-shot outcome of every evaluation, so future decoders and devices can be compared.
summary_zh: 量子纠错解码器通常基于合成电路级噪声开展基准测试，学界普遍假设该噪声下的解码器性能排序可迁移到真实硬件，且随着噪声模型越来越贴合实际，排序结果会越来越准确。首个运行在表面码阈值以下的Willow量子处理器为验证该假设提供了条件。本文使用保真度逐步提升的4级噪声模型，在3种码距、2种基、15轮计数的真实硬件数据上对6款解码器开展性能排序。结果表明，只有当噪声模型为每类操作单独设置错误率时，得到的排序结果才与硬件实测排序一致。将噪声模型校准到设备实测值可降低绝对错误率，但不会提升排序结果与硬件的一致性。本文还首次在真实硬件上对NVIDIA的伊辛预解码器开展独立评估，测试场景的码距低于其训练感受野，且通过映射将其适配到训练所用的格点结构上。在该场景下，该预解码器不存在精度-延迟优势：280组对比实验中，有278组其他参测解码器的单周期错误率和解码延迟都与其持平或更优。本文公开了完整的测试流水线和所有评估的单次运行结果，方便后续研究对新解码器和新硬件开展对比。

title: Fast Surrogate Modeling of Excitable and Oscillatory FitzHugh-Nagumo Dynamics with Parametric Neural Operators
title_zh: 基于参数神经算子的可激发与振荡FitzHugh-Nagumo动力学快速代理建模
authors: Andrew Franck, Justin Li
abstract: The FitzHugh-Nagumo (FHN) system serves as a simplified model of neuronal voltage dynamics, capturing the activator-inhibitor structure behind both isolated action potentials and the rhythmic spiking seen across the brain. Exploring its 5D physiological parameter space is important for neuromodulation and mapping voltage recordings back to biophysics, yet classical finite-difference solvers make rapid parameter sweeps expensive. We train parameter-conditioned Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) as fast, differentiable surrogates for the FHN voltage and recovery fields on a one-dimensional spatial domain, conditioning each Fourier layer on the parameter vector $\lambda = (D_u, D_v, a, b, \tau)$ via feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). We apply a single bifurcation analysis that delimits the two distinct regimes the model spans, oscillatory (tonic firing) and excitable (action-potential propagation), and we train one operator in each. In the oscillatory regime the surrogate attains sub-$0.1\%$ relative $L^2$ error on both fields, runs nearly three orders of magnitude faster than the finite-difference baseline, generalizes uniformly across the parameter space, and extrapolates to low single-digit percentage errors outside of the training bounds. In the excitable regime the same operator accurately reproduces the firing threshold and the $c \propto \sqrt{D_u}$ conduction-velocity law and replicates full traveling pulses, fully capturing the excitable bifurcation structure rather than just smoothly interpolating fields.
summary_zh: FitzHugh-Nagumo（FHN，菲茨休-南云）系统是神经元电压动力学的简化模型，可表征孤立动作电位和全脑范围内观测到的节律性尖峰背后的激活-抑制结构。探索其5维生理参数空间对神经调控和电压记录的生物物理映射至关重要，但传统有限差分求解器的参数遍历计算成本极高。本文训练参数条件化傅里叶神经算子（FNO）作为一维空间域上FHN电压场和恢复场的快速可微代理模型，通过特征线性调制（FiLM）将每个傅里叶层与参数向量λ=(D_u,D_v,a,b,τ)关联。本文首先开展分岔分析，划分出模型覆盖的两种不同区域：振荡区（强直放电）和可激发区（动作电位传播），并针对两个区域分别训练专用算子。在振荡区，代理模型在两个场上的相对L²误差低于0.1%，推理速度比有限差分基线快近3个数量级，在整个参数空间内泛化性能均匀，在训练边界外的外推误差也仅为个位数百分比。在可激发区，同一算子可准确复现放电阈值和传导速度定律c∝√D_u，还原完整的行波脉冲，不仅能平滑插值场值，还能完整捕捉可激发分岔结构。

title: Mitra-v2 Technical Report
title_zh: Mitra-v2技术报告
authors: Yefan Tao, Xiyuan Zhang, Xinyi Liu, Boran Han, Danielle Maddix 等 (16 人)
abstract: We introduce Mitra-v2, a tabular foundation model that delivers state-of-the-art performance on real-world classification and regression problems, from credit-risk scoring and clinical prediction to equipment-failure detection and house-price estimation. Mitra-v2 is trained only on synthetic data, with a pretraining distribution that is much larger and more diverse than Mitra-v1's. Built on a small 2D Transformer backbone, Mitra-v2 supports longer contexts and larger feature spaces. Improved optimization lets it learn from this larger task distribution. We evaluate Mitra-v2 on the TabArena and TALENT benchmarks, comprising more than 300 real-world datasets under two evaluation protocols. On the full TabArena benchmark, Mitra-v2 delivers state-of-the-art performance at the level of the industry-scale TabFM and EXAONE Tabular models, while surpassing TabPFN-3 by a wide margin in both classification and regression. Mitra-v2 matches the 1.6B-parameter TabFM with only 5% of its size (77M parameters), delivering frontier performance at a fraction of the cost. On TALENT, Mitra-v2 remains among the leading models, clearly outperforming TabPFN-3 and TabICLv2. It also ranks first on classification tasks with more than ten classes, even though it was pretrained only on tasks with at most ten classes. These results make Mitra-v2 one of the strongest and most broadly applicable open tabular foundation models released to date. We release the model weights, the inference and fine-tuning code, and our evaluation results under the Apache-2.0 license.
summary_zh: 本文提出Mitra-v2表格基础模型，在信用评分、临床预测、设备故障检测、房价估计等真实世界分类和回归任务上达到了当前最优性能。Mitra-v2仅在合成数据上训练，其预训练分布的规模和多样性远高于Mitra-v1。该模型基于轻量的2D Transformer骨干网络构建，支持更长的上下文和更大的特征空间，优化算法的改进使其可从更大规模的任务分布中学习。本文在包含300余个真实数据集的TabArena和TALENT基准集上，采用两种评估协议对Mitra-v2开展测试。在完整TabArena基准集上，Mitra-v2的性能达到工业级TabFM和EXAONE Tabular模型的水平，在分类和回归任务上大幅超越TabPFN-3。Mitra-v2仅77M参数，规模仅为16亿参数TabFM的5%，却能达到与其相当的前沿性能，推理成本极低。在TALENT基准集上，Mitra-v2同样处于第一梯队，性能明显优于TabPFN-3和TabICLv2。即使其预训练任务的类别数最多仅为10类，在类别数大于10的分类任务上仍能取得排名第一的表现。上述结果表明Mitra-v2是目前已公开的性能最强、适用范围最广的开源表格基础模型之一。本文在Apache-2.0许可下公开了模型权重、推理与微调代码以及全部评估结果。

title: Distilled Continuous Diffusion Language Models Can Write Code in Few Steps---or One
title_zh: 经过蒸馏的连续扩散语言模型可在少步甚至单步内生成代码
authors: Fred Zhangzhi Peng, Kaiwen Zheng, Anru R. Zhang
abstract: Language generation is almost universally treated as a sequential process: autoregressive models emit one token at a time, while diffusion language models replace token-level seriality with a long trajectory of iterative refinement. In this work, we introduce PlaidQ, a 0.7B continuous diffusion language model for code generation, and show that its trajectory can be aggressively distilled into only a few denoising steps---or even one, enabling efficient code generation. PlaidQ repurposes a pretrained autoregressive model as a bidirectional denoiser over continuous token embeddings. We distill PlaidQ with distribution matching for few-step generation and paired-trajectory supervision for one-step generation. At matched model scale, PlaidQ is competitive with discrete diffusion language models on code generation. Distillation then shifts the quality--compute frontier: a 16-step student reaches 31.78 and 40.49 pass@10 on HumanEval and MBPP+, surpassing the same PlaidQ teacher sampled for 512 steps. At the extreme, paired-trajectory distillation achieves 7.07 pass@1 on HumanEval with a single denoising step, producing functionally correct programs. Together, these results establish continuous diffusion as a viable path to few-step and one-step code generation. Broadly, continuous diffusion is not merely another representation for language: it provides an interface through which language models can inherit the acceleration and distillation machinery of continuous diffusion modeling. Training and inference code and model checkpoints are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 目前语言生成几乎都被视为串行过程：自回归模型逐token生成，而扩散语言模型用长迭代细化轨迹替代token级串行操作。本文提出PlaidQ，一个面向代码生成的0.7B参数连续扩散语言模型，证明其生成轨迹可被大幅蒸馏为仅几步甚至一步去噪，实现高效代码生成。PlaidQ将预训练自回归模型复用于连续token嵌入空间的双向去噪器，通过分布匹配实现少步生成，通过配对轨迹监督实现单步生成。在相同模型规模下，PlaidQ在代码生成任务上的性能与离散扩散语言模型相当。蒸馏操作进一步拓展了质量-计算效率边界：16步推理的学生模型在HumanEval和MBPP+数据集上的pass@10指标分别达到31.78和40.49，性能超过采用512步采样的PlaidQ教师模型。在极端场景下，配对轨迹蒸馏仅用单步去噪就在HumanEval上达到7.07的pass@1指标，可生成功能完全正确的程序。上述结果证明连续扩散是实现少步、单步代码生成的可行路径。更广泛地说，连续扩散不仅是语言的另一种表示形式，还为语言模型提供了可复用连续扩散建模领域成熟加速与蒸馏技术的接口。训练、推理代码和模型检查点已公开在对应链接中。

title: An Energy-Based Conservative-Dissipative Latent Neural Evolution Operator for Magnetization Dynamics
title_zh: 面向磁化动力学的基于能量的保守-耗散潜神经演化算子
authors: Sebastian Schaffer, Lukas Exl
abstract: We develop an energy-based reduced-order model for micromagnetic magnetization dynamics that couples a convolutional autoencoder to a structured latent neural ordinary differential equation. Motivated by the precessional-dissipative structure of the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, the latent vector field is generated from the gradient of a learned scalar potential through an antisymmetric operator and a symmetric positive-semidefinite dissipative operator. This potential is learned in nonunique latent coordinates and is not identified with the Gibbs free energy, but decreases monotonically along autonomous continuous-time solutions, while the antisymmetric component permits motion along its level sets. The encoder, decoder, latent energy, and operators are trained jointly on short trajectory windows using latent and decoded-rollout losses alone, without time-derivative supervision, physical-energy labels, or dissipation penalties. At inference, an initial state is encoded once, evolved in latent space, and decoded only at the requested output times, enabling substantially cheaper trajectory prediction than the micromagnetic solver used to generate the training data. We compare quadratic, deep, and additive deep-quadratic latent energies on two datasets parameterized by field amplitude and generated for the two applied-field directions of the NIST $\mu$MAG Standard Problem 4. Dissipative-only and antisymmetric-dissipative models achieve comparable accuracy on short training-style windows but differ substantially on uninterrupted rollouts, for which the antisymmetric-dissipative models provide markedly more accurate trajectory predictions. The deep-quadratic energy gives the best overall accuracy for both field directions and exhibits slower error growth when rollouts are extended to twice the training horizon.
summary_zh: 本文针对微磁磁化动力学开发了一种基于能量的降阶模型，该模型将卷积自编码器与结构化潜神经常微分方程相结合。受朗道-栗弗席兹-吉尔伯特（Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert）方程的进动-耗散结构启发，该模型通过反对称算子和对称半正定耗散算子，从学习得到的标量势的梯度生成潜向量场。该势函数在非唯一的潜坐标中学习，不与吉布斯自由能等同，但在自治连续时间解的路径上单调递减，而反对称分量允许运动沿其等值面进行。编码器、解码器、潜能量和算子仅使用潜空间损失和解码滚动损失在短轨迹窗口上联合训练，无需时间导数监督、物理能量标签或耗散惩罚。在推理阶段，初始状态仅需编码一次，在潜空间中演化，且仅在请求的输出时刻解码，与用于生成训练数据的微磁求解器相比，该方法可大幅降低轨迹预测成本。我们在由场强参数化、针对NIST μMAG标准问题4的两个外加场方向生成的两个数据集上，对比了二次型、深度型和加性深度二次型潜能量的表现。仅含耗散的模型和反对称-耗散模型在短训练窗口上的精度相当，但在不间断滚动预测中表现差异显著，反对称-耗散模型的轨迹预测精度明显更高。深度二次型能量在两个场方向上的整体精度最优，且当滚动预测时长扩展到训练视界的两倍时，其误差增长更慢。
